caption: The drawing depicts three views of a clothing ensemble, specifically a woman's cape and skirt. The central, largest view is of the front: the cape is mauve with a brown floral or vine-like pattern, trimmed with a black or dark edge, worn over a dress with long, light-colored sleeves featuring a small pattern and a skirt adorned with horizontal bands of beige, brown, and light pink or red floral motifs. To the upper right, a side view of the ensemble is shown, highlighting the cape’s draping and the layers of the patterned skirt beneath. The lower right shows the back view: the cape maintains its mauve coloration with brown patterning and extends over the top of the skirt, while the sleeves and lower skirt are partly visible. The background is off-white, and some brownish stains or marks are visible across the paper.
title: Cape
